vicfalls.name: Mapopoma eVhitori
vicfalls.desc: Chimwe chezvishamiso zvinomwe zvenyika, mapopoma makuru pasi rose
vicfalls.summary: Inozivikanwa nemuno seMosi-oa-Tunya (Utsi Hunotinhira), Victoria Falls yakapetwa kaviri pakukwirira kune Niagara Falls. Nakidzwa nekukwira magwa, bungee jumping, nhabvu dzemundege, uye Devil's Pool inozivikanwa kwazvo.
quickFacts: Located on the Zambezi River at the Zimbabwe-Zambia border.
Approximate width is 1.7 km with a drop of over 100 m at its deepest sections.
Protected within the Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls World Heritage landscape.
experiences: Scenic viewpoints, rainforest walks, and photography trails.
Adventure options such as rafting, bungee jumping, and helicopter flights.
Nearby safari and river experiences in surrounding protected areas.
vicfalls.bestTime: Chiratidziro chemvura yakakwirira chinowanzosimba kubva mumwaka wekunaya kwemvura kusvika mumwaka wekusanaya kwemvura; mwedzi-yemvura yakaderera inowanzofarirwa kune mamwe mabasa ekuita.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Masvingo ekare anoratidza budiriro nehunyanzvi hwekuvaka hweAfrica
greatzim.summary: Yakavakwa pakati pezana ramakore rechi11 nerechi15, Great Zimbabwe ndiyo yaive guta guru reUmambo hweZimbabwe. Masvingo aya akavakwa nemabwe pasina dhaka. Nzvimbo iyi ndiyo yakapa nyika zita rayo.
quickFacts: Constructed and expanded between the 11th and 15th centuries.
Famous for dry-stone masonry built without mortar.
Represents the political and cultural center of the historic Zimbabwe civilization.
experiences: Explore the Hill Complex, Great Enclosure, and Valley Ruins.
Interpretive historical tours and local cultural storytelling.
Panoramic viewpoints over the wider Masvingo landscape.
greatzim.bestTime: Inowanikwa gore rose; mwaka wakaoma mwedzi kazhinji zviri nani pakufamba uye kuongorora nzvimbo.

kariba.name: Dhamu reKariba
kariba.desc: Rimwe remadziva makuru akaitwa nevanhu, rakanakira kukwira magwa nekuredza hove
kariba.summary: Dziva reKariba rakakura kudarika 5,500 square kilometers parwizi rwaZambezi. Rakakurumbira nekuredza tiger fish, maholide emagwa (houseboats), nekuvira kwezuva kunoyevedza.
quickFacts: Sits on the Zambezi corridor and supports both tourism and recreation.
Popular for boat-based travel, fishing tourism, and sunset cruises.
Connected to nearby wildlife areas including Matusadona-facing zones.
experiences: Game-viewing combinations with lake and park circuits.
kariba.bestTime: Mwaka wakaoma unowanzo kufarirwa kuona mhuka dzesango; zviitiko zvemudhamu zvinoshanda mukati megore rose.

rocks.name: Mabwe Anoshamisa
rocks.summary: Mabwe aya anoonekwa pamari yeZimbabwe uye anowanikwa munyika yose, zvikuru muMatobo National Park. Akasikwa nemamiriro ekunze mukufamba kwemakore akawanda.
quickFacts: Prominent around Matobo and other granite landscapes.
Featured in national symbolism, including currency imagery.
Formed through weathering and erosion of ancient granite outcrops.
experiences: Landscape photography and short nature walks.
Rock-art and heritage combinations in Matobo areas.
Scenic drives linking Harare and Matobo viewpoints.
rocks.bestTime: Kukwezva kwegore rose; yakajeka yakaoma-mwaka mamiriro ekunze kazhinji inopa yakanyanya kunaka kuoneka kwemifananidzo.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Wanawo maonero emadziva, kufamba mumakomo nenzvimbo dzakanyarara dzemhuka. Enzanisa nzvimbo usati wasarudza nzira.

mining.title: Zvekushandisa nemasevhisi emigodhi
mining.summary: Ongorora kutengesa mbatya dzebasa, kurojesa maturusi kana kugadzirisa pombi dzemvura kumigodhi iri kutoshanda.
mining.start: Edza odha imwe chete yemutengi nemushandi akavimbika ari kumusha. Kugadzirisa kuitwe nevanhu vane hunyanzvi.
mining.budget: Zvinotengeswa kana maturusi, kutakura, kugadzirisa uye mari yekumirira vatengi vanononoka kubhadhara.
mining.checks: Simbisa kodzero dzemugodhi, nhoroondo yekubhadhara kwemutengi nekuchengeteka pabasa. Ongorora mvumo inodiwa pabasa rako. Kutenga kana kushandisa mugodhi kunoda ongororo yakasiyana yenyanzvi nemutemo.
mining.customers: Migodhi iri kushanda, zvikwata zvinogadzirisa michina nemakondirakiti ari munzvimbo inokwanisika kusvitsa zvinhu.
mining.income: Odha dzezvinhu, kurojesa michina kana kugadzirisa. Verenga kutakura, kusakara kwematurusi nekunonoka kubhadharwa musati mabvumirana mutengo.
mining.improvement: Nyora runyorwa rwemapatsi nezvinhu zviripo. Tanga waedza odha kuti uone vatengi usati watenga mimwe michina.
mining.monitor: Enzanisa mainivhoisi, magwaro ekugamuchira zvinhu akasainwa nemari yabhadharwa. Nyora mamiriro ematurusi asati arojeswa uye adzoka.

farming.title: Kurima nekugadzira chikafu
farming.summary: Ongorora miriwo, mbesa kana boka rimwe rehuku nemurimi ane ruzivo ari kumusha.
farming.start: Tsvaga mutengi uye bvumiranai uwandu nemhando yezvinodiwa usati wabhadhara mwaka mumwe kana boka rimwe rehuku.
farming.budget: Mbeu kana nhiyo, chikafu chezvipfuwo, mvura, vashandi, hutano hwezvirimwa kana zvipfuwo, kutakura nekurasikirwa.
farming.checks: Simbisa kodzero dzekushandisa ivhu, mvura yakavimbika nezvibvumirano zvemutengi. Bvunza nyanzvi dzekurima; mamiriro ekunze, zvirwere nezvisingatengeswi zvinogona kupedza mari yemwaka.
farming.customers: Zvitoro zvekudya, vatengesi vemusika, maresitorendi kana mutengi wezvirimwa anogona kutsanangura uwandu nemhando yaanoda.
farming.income: Tengesa zvirimwa kana mbesa neodha yakabvumiranwa. Verenga zvarambwa, zvakarasika nemari yekutakura pakuongorora mwaka.
farming.improvement: Shandisa karenda yekurima nekushandisa mvura uchibatsirwa nenyanzvi. Edza madiridziro mushure mekuongorora mvura nemutengo.
farming.monitor: Kumbira marisiti, mishumo ine mazuva, uremu hwegoho nemarisiti evatengi. Enzanisa zvakakohwewa, zvakatengeswa, zvakarasika nezvakabhadharwa.

construction.title: Kuvaka nekuvandudza dzimba
construction.summary: Ongorora kutengesa zvekuvakisa, kurojesa maturusi kana chikwata chidiki chekugadzirisa nekupedzisa dzimba.
construction.start: Verenga mari yebasa rimwe rakajeka nenyanzvi, nyorai zvinofanira kuitwa uye bhadharai kana basa raongororwa.
construction.budget: Zvekuvakisa, maturusi, vashandi, kutakura, kugadzirisazve uye kunonoka kubhadharwa.
construction.checks: Tarisa mabasa akamboitwa nemuvaki nemvumo inodiwa nekanzuru. Pamapurojekiti evhu kana dzimba, muridzi nemvumo yekuvaka ngazviongororwe nemunhu akazvimirira.

construction.customers: Varidzi vedzimba, vanorojesa dzimba, zvitoro zvidiki nemakondirakiti ane basa rakajeka.
construction.income: Ipa mutengo wezvinhu, kurojesa maturusi kana basa. Nyora zvinosanganisirwa nemitengo yekuwedzera basa risati ratanga.
construction.improvement: Shandisa runyorwa rwezvekuvakisa rwamunogovana nemifananidzo ine mazuva. Batanidza zvakatengwa nebasa rimwe nerimwe.
construction.monitor: Enzanisa zvekuvakisa zvasvitswa nemainivhoisi. Rongai kuongorora kwakazvimirira musati mabhadhara chinhanho chimwe nechimwe.

food.title: Kugadzira nekuputira chikafu
food.summary: Ongorora kuomesa zvirimwa, chikafu chinogadzirwa zvishoma kana zvekuputira chikafu kumabhizimisi emuno.
food.start: Edza chigadzirwa chimwe nevatengi vashoma, panzvimbo yakachena yakakodzera chikafu uye nenzira yekugadzira kana kuputira inodzokororwa.

food.customers: Zvitoro, vanobikira vanhu nevarimi kana vagadziri vanoda zvekuputira zvakakodzera.
food.income: Tengesa mapoka ezvigadzirwa kana zvekuputira pamutengo wakaverengwa. Sanganisira vashandi, marara, zvinodzoserwa nenguva yekubhadharwa nezvitoro.
food.improvement: Shandisa zviyero zvakafanana pamapaketi uye nyora boka rimwe nerimwe. Bvunza vatengi nezvemhando, mavara nemutengo usati wawedzera basa.
food.monitor: Nyora zvakashandiswa, uwandu hwagadzirwa, zvarambwa nezvatengeswa. Enzanisa chikafu nezvekuputira zvasara nemari yapinda.

solar.title: Masevhisi ezuva nemvura
solar.summary: Ongorora kutengesa midziyo nekuronga kugadzirisa nenyanzvi dzemagetsi ezuva nemvura.

solar.budget: Maturusi, midziyo yekuyedza, mapatsi, kutakura, vashandi vane hunyanzvi nekudzokera kunogadzirisa pasi pewaranti.
solar.checks: Ongorora hunyanzvi hwemushandi, zvinodiwa pamidziyo newaranti yakanyorwa. Simbisa mvumo yemabasa emagetsi kana mvura uye nzira yakachengeteka yekusvika pabasa.

solar.customers: Mhuri, zvitoro zvidiki nemapurazi ane midziyo inoda kuongororwa nenyanzvi kana kugadziriswa.
solar.income: Bhadharisa midziyo yakabvumiranwa nebasa rapera. Patsanura mutengo wemidziyo, vashandi nekuzotevera mugwaro remutengo.
solar.improvement: Chengeta runyorwa rwemidziyo, mazuva ekugadzirisa, nhamba dzayo newaranti. Bvumiranai nenyanzvi purogiramu yekugadzirisa.
solar.monitor: Kumbira magwaro ebasa, kuedza nekugamuchidza, mainivhoisi nekusaina kwemutengi. Ongorora matambudziko anodzokororwa usati watenga zvimwe.

regulations.title: Gwara reMitemo neKutevedzera
regulations.subtitle: Mirayiridzo inoshanda yemitemo kune vadyari vediaspora, vatengesi vekunze, nevadzoki kumusha. Shandisai izvi serunyoro rwekuita basa, uye enzanisai zvisarudzo zvekupedzisira nenyanzvi dzemutemo, mutero, nechikamu chebhizimusi.

investment_compliance.title: Kutevedzera mitemo pakudyara
points: Simbisa chimiro chepamutemo chechirongwa, varidzi, uye hutungamiri hwebhodhi usati wapa mari.
Tarisa marezinesi nemvumo kuburikidza neZIDA nevatariri vechikamu vane basa.
Shandisa zvibvumirano zvakanyorwa zvevane migove nehutungamiri pakudyara pamwe chete nediaspora.
Nyora kwakabva mari uye ita KYC/AML kuvanhu kana masangano amuri kushanda nawo.

currency_settlement.title: Mari, kudzorerwa kwemari, nekubhadhara
points: Bvumiranai mari yekubhadhara (USD/ZiG/zvimwe) nenguva dzekubhadhara muzvibvumirano.
Tsanangurai zvakajeka migove (dividends) nenzira dzekubuda kune vanotora chikamu vediaspora.
Shandisa nzira dzemabhanga dzinoenderana nemitemo uye dzinotevedzeka pakufamba kwemari.
Isa zvinobata njodzi dzeFX nekutamiswa kwemari mumagwaro ekudyara (term sheets).

export_controls.title: Kudzorwa kwekutengesa kunze
points: Simbisa HS classification, zvinorambidzwa mumusika wekuenda, nemvumo inodiwa.
Chengetedza mapakeji ezvitupa: mavambo, phytosanitary, nemagwaro ehunhu.
Enzanisa kunyora pamapakeji, kupakata, nekutevedza chigadzirwa nemitemo yemusika wekuenda.
Shandisa vanotakura zvinhu necustoms broker vakabvumidzwa pazvigadzirwa zvinodzorwa.

export_certification_and_labeling.title: Zvitupa nekulebhela
points: Mapa chigadzirwa chimwe nechimwe kumazinga anodiwa musati matanga kushanda nevatengi.
Ita pre-audit yenzvimbo nemagwaro usati waenda kuongororo yezvitupa zvekunze.
Chengetedza lot-level traceability yezvekudya, wellness, nezvigadzirwa zvemaoko zvinotengeswa kunze.
Ita ongororo dzenguva nenguva dzekutevedzera mitemo kudzivirira kuvharirwa pamuganhu nezvirango.

tourism_entry_and_safety.title: Kupinda munyika nekuchengeteka kwekushanya
points: Tarisa rudzi rwevisa, nguva inobvumidzwa yekugara, uye kushanda kwemagwaro usati wafamba.
Iva neinishuwarenzi yerwendo inoenderana nemabasa aunoronga nezvinodiwa zveutano.
Simbisa nzira dzekubhadhara nemiganhu yekutengeserana kare.
Tevedza mitemo yemuno yemapaki, migwagwa, nezvekugara.

due_diligence_checklist.title: Runyorwa rweDue Diligence rweDiaspora
points: Kuongorora kambani, UBO checks, pamwe nekuongorora nyaya dzematare kana zvirango.
Kuongorora zvibvumirano pazvekutengeserana, mutero, nekugadzirisa kupokana.
Uchapupu hwekushanda: kushanya kwenzvimbo, mabhuku emari akaongororwa, nekuongorora vatengesi.
Kudzora kunoenderera: nguva dzemishumo, kutevera KPI, uye matrix yekukwidziridza nyaya.
